claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Triamterene is a diuretic sodium channel blocker with no known cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak effects reflecting nonspecific physicochemical or off-target activity rather than a defined killing mechanism.
